title: Liberty Falls Water Tower AH173 – 1998 Collectible Miniature Building - No Flag
descriptionText:
Add a charming piece of Americana to your collection with this Liberty Falls Water Tower (AH173) miniature building, part of the beloved Liberty Falls Americana Collection by International Resourcing Services. This detailed hand-painted resin sculpture depicts a classic small-town water tower with a red brick base, green cylindrical tank, and lifelike details such as ladders, vines, barrels, and rooftop accessories.
Released in 1998, this piece captures the nostalgic spirit of Liberty Falls — a quaint and historic town series cherished by collectors worldwide.
Features:
Model: AH173 Liberty Falls Water Tower
Manufacturer: International Resourcing Services, Inc.
Year: 1998
Material: Hand-painted resin
Marked on bottom with original gold label
Excellent craftsmanship and attention to detail
Part of the Liberty Falls Americana Collection
